text: Cald. returned. , Or, chiefe marshall. Cald. chiefe of the executioners or slaughtermen.
Cald. from before God. , Or, that they should not destroy Daniel, &c.
Cald. that I haue found. , Cald. children of the captiuitie of Iudah.
Or, which was not in hands. As verse 45.
Cald. their dayes. , Chap.4.3, 34. and 6. 27. and 7. 14, 27. mich 4.7. luke 1.33. , Cald. kingdome thereof.
Or, which was not in hand. , Cald. after this.
